# Palette

## Frame {#palette-frame}

The shipped single-seed example must derive the whole palette.

# Badge look {.section-badge}

The badge fill comes from `--beamer-section-badge-bg`, which the palette derives from
`--beamer-section-title-bg`: it must follow the seed too.

# Minimal look {.section-minimal}

The minimal section title takes `--beamer-section-minimal-fg`, derived from
`--beamer-structure`, and must follow the seed as well.

## A frame with a block {#palette-block-frame}

::: {.block title="Block title"}
The block title's text colour is a derivation surface too.
:::

::: {.exampleblock title="Example title"}
The example title is a derivation surface too: CambridgeUS takes `example text`,
Madrid pins its own literal.
:::
